description.value: Il Posto is a rustic Italian restaurant in the heart of historic Ladner village, helmed by award-winning chef Terry Pichor — a two-time Gold Medal Plates regional champion and former executive chef of the acclaimed Relais & Châteaux property Sonora Resort. The kitchen focuses on sharing-style Italian food built around fresh, locally sourced ingredients, giving the spot a neighbourhood warmth that has made it popular with both locals and visitors. Cyclists passing through Ladner's compact village core will find a sit-down lunch, brunch, and dinner option with reservations available online.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully loads and confirms the OSM address (4866 Delta Street, Ladner, BC) and phone (604.946.1300), establishing the business is real and operating. The OSM tag takeaway=yes is loosely corroborated by the website's 'Hosting at Home & Gift Certificates' section. No website or OSM evidence addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most optional amenities, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating Italian restaurant with confirmed address, phone, live website, and online booking — a solid stop for touring cyclists in Ladner.
